_comment: Public configuration read by the browser (assets/js/site.js) and by tools/build_site.py. NEVER put a secret here: this file is downloaded by every visitor. publicBaseUrl: canonical address of the site (check it with tools/check_live.py before announcing it). apiBaseUrl: address of the form backend (empty = forms say they are not connected). contactEmail: general address (footer, forms not connected). supportEmail: customer support address (footer, contact page).
